title: The Morning Build
summary: Six stories from 22 sources · about 9 minutes

lead.title: Merge queues stop being a big-company thing
lead.dek: Three small studios run one now. What it took, and the one setting each of them changed in the first week.
lead.body:
A merge queue is a line your pull requests wait in, so main is never broken by two changes that pass alone.

The cost is a few minutes per merge.

stories.title: Shader caches, measured
stories.dek: Cold starts fell by a third once the cache moved next to the build.

stories.title: Tutorials that teach by taking away
stories.dek: Removing a mechanic for one level, then giving it back.
